cues.en: Instructor: I know you guys really enjoy working through these unsupervised learning challenges, so I have another one here just for you.
cues.zh: 講師：我知道各位很喜歡完成這些無監督學習挑戰，所以又特別準備了一題給你。

cues.en: Now, so far in this section, I've been talking about confidence intervals exclusively in the context of computing the means, so the average.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，本單元談信賴區間時，都只針對平均值來說明。

cues.en: Computing these sample average, and seeing how that relates to the population average and so on.
cues.zh: 也就是計算樣本平均值，看看它與母體平均值有什麼關係等等。

cues.en: But as I mentioned at the end of the previous video, one of the advantages of bootstrapping for confidence intervals, empirical confidence intervals,
cues.zh: 不過，正如我在上一支影片結尾提到的，透過拔靴法取得經驗信賴區間的一個優點，

cues.en: is that you can use this method to get confidence intervals around any parameter you want, any statistic, any characteristic of the dataset.
cues.zh: 就是可以用這種方法，取得任何參數、任何統計量，或資料集任何特徵的信賴區間。

cues.en: So what you want to do here is compute empirical confidence intervals based on the bootstrapping method, not for the mean,
cues.zh: 所以這裡要你用拔靴法計算經驗信賴區間，但這次不是針對平均值，

cues.en: but instead, for the sample standard deviation.
So you want to get a 95% confidence interval around our sample standard deviation, which is an estimate of the population standard deviation.
cues.zh: 我們要取得樣本標準差的 95% 信賴區間；樣本標準差是母體標準差的估計值。

cues.en: Now, I'm not gonna tell you what you need to change or how you need to change it.
cues.zh: 我不會告訴你需要改什麼，或要怎麼改。

cues.en: That's up to you to figure out.
But it shouldn't be too difficult because you have most of the code that you need already in this file for you, and of course, the corresponding code in the Python file.
cues.zh: 不過，應該不會太難，因為所需的程式碼大部分都已經在這份檔案，以及對應的 Python 檔案中了。
